rev6.release_notes: Simulate: Shift + drag and right drag now turn the view freely, on over the top and underneath. Continue Pattern stops exactly at a CONTINUE UNTIL value (e.g. CONTINUE UNTIL Z-1.6551) and never goes past it.

cadcam.release_notes: Toolpath Extension: type a length and every cutting pass runs on that much further at both ends (Face, 2D Contour, Roughing, 2D Pocket, 3D Finish, Edge Break). Hide a body (its Browser dot, or right-click Hide / Show Body). Export a drawing as a 3D PDF or a 3D sheet you can turn in any browser. A setup can start from the stock the setup before it left, and Export Stock saves what the toolpaths leave. Simulate turns freely with Shift + drag. Separated toolpaths show the Separate symbol on both. Finer arcs on follow Roughing.
